states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter state codes to import. Leave empty for all 50 states.

targetWithPhones.title: Target rows with phones
targetWithPhones.description: Stop once this many breeders with at least one phone number are saved (0 = no limit).

onlyWithPhones.title: Only save rows with phones
onlyWithPhones.description: Skip breeders whose contact details have no phone number.

whenThrottled.title: When throttled
whenThrottled.description: What to do when angus.org starts refusing contact lookups (after one retry on a fresh session). 'Stop and save progress' ends the run quickly so you don't pay for idle waiting: run it again later, or put it on a schedule (e.g. every 30 minutes), and it continues with new breeders only. 'Wait and retry' pauses inside the run instead.
enumTitles: Stop and save progress (rerun or schedule later)
Wait and retry inside this run

delaySeconds.title: Delay between contact lookups (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Pause before each breeder contact lookup. Slower pacing hits angus.org's rate limit less often.

blockPauseMinutes.title: Pause when throttled (minutes)
blockPauseMinutes.description: Only used when 'When throttled' is 'Wait and retry'. How long to wait after angus.org starts returning empty lookups; doubles on each consecutive block, up to 120 minutes.

maxBreeders.title: Max breeders
maxBreeders.description: Stop after this many breeders are saved (0 = no limit). Useful for test runs.

excludeDatasetIds.title: Skip breeders from earlier datasets
excludeDatasetIds.description: Dataset IDs from runs made before this version (e.g. your first Nebraska run). Breeders in them are added to the skip list once; later runs remember them automatically.

resetProgress.title: Start over
resetProgress.description: Forget which breeders and states earlier runs imported, and import everything again.

allRowsDatasetName.title: Combined dataset name
allRowsDatasetName.description: Every new row is also added to this named dataset, so all runs end up in one place for export. Leave empty to turn off.

progressStoreName.title: Progress store name
progressStoreName.description: Named key-value store that remembers imported breeders between runs. Use a different name to keep a separate list.
